text_block_list.text: While heading to the training room...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I was hoping you might join me for tea
when you
have time.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Of course! You may invite my royal
presence
whenever!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I shall indeed. Well then, until
next time.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
That was great. I wonder what kind of
Japanese
sweets she'll bring next?
Hehe...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: King! What excellent timing.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello, McQueen! Can I help you
with
something?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I was wondering if you'd like to
accompany me to
a dessert buffet. The
restaurant is well-connected
with the
Mejiro family.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
That sounds lovely! It would give us a
chance to
relax as well.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I've also heard that special seasonal
cakes will be
available. I hope you'll
look forward to them!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: I'll be in touch.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Now I have a treat waiting for me
after
training! ♪
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: There you are, King!
text_block_list.name: Bob-cut Umamusume

text_block_list.text: Oh my, I'm quite popular today.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Hey, do you want to join us for some
sweets after
school tomorrow?
text_block_list.name: Cat-eyed Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure I can make time for that! I am a

magnanimous king, after all!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: You're the best! ♪
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало's Followers

text_block_list.text:
Тренер? Did you want to make plans
with me
too?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
So be it! Whatever desserts may come, I
stand
ready to devour them!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

I'm glad to see you're getting along so well with
everyone!

text_block_list.text:
So be it! Whatever desserts may come, I
stand
ready to devour them!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: Aren't you eating a bit too much sugar?

I'm glad to see you're getting along so well with
everyone!

text_block_list.text:
Are you suggesting I would be so
negligent in
managing my weight as to
consume a surplus of
calories?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Hah! Inconceivable!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Well, um, maybe I could give your words
a bit
more consideration...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Oh? You think so?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I suppose my royal virtue wins over many
hearts!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Don't be shy—you can always invite me
out for
tea as well!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Just make sure you have some sweets
ready.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Ohohoho!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
From now on, I'll have people invite me
to less
calorie-dense outings!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I later hear that Кинг Хало is often
invited out
because of her friendliness
and sweet tooth.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
